description: Copies one voltage onto every channel of a polyphonic signal, and offers four identical copies of the result

params.text: Sets how many channels the outputs carry, 1 to 16

inputs.text: The voltage to be copied; only its first channel is read, whatever is patched

outputs.text: A polyphonic output with the input voltage on every channel

notes: bypassing this module passes the input jack straight to all four outputs rather than silencing them

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
